verses.textZh: 耶和华的话临到亚米太的儿子约拿，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话临到亚米太的儿子约拿，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话临到亚米太的儿子约拿，说：
verses.textEnNiv: The word of the Lord came to Jonah son of Amittai:
verses.textEnEsv: Now the word of the Lord came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave this message to Jonah son of Amittai:
verses.textEnNasb: The word of the Lord came to Jonah the son of Amittai, saying,
verses.textEn: The word of the Lord came to Jonah son of Amittai:

verses.textZh: "起来！到尼尼微大城去，警告其中的居民，因为他们的恶行已经达到我面前。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "起来！到尼尼微大城去，警告其中的居民，因为他们的恶行已经达到我面前。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你起来往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民呼喊，因为他们的恶达到我面前。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me."
verses.textEnEsv: "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and call out against it, for their evil has come up before me."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and cry out against it; for their wickedness has come up before Me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Get up and go to the great city of Nineveh. Announce my judgment against it because I have seen how wicked its people are."
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, go to Nineveh, the great city, and cry out against it, because their wickedness has come up before Me."
verses.textEn: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before me."

verses.textZh: 可是约拿却起来，要逃往他施去，躲避耶和华；他下到约帕，找到了一只要开往他施去的船；他给了钱，就上船 ，要和他们同往他施去，离开耶和华。
verses.textZhCnvs: 可是约拿却起来，要逃往他施去，躲避耶和华；他下到约帕，找到了一只要开往他施去的船；他给了钱，就上船 ，要和他们同往他施去，离开耶和华。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿却起来，逃往他施去躲避耶和华；下到约帕，遇见一只船，要往他施去。他就给了船价，上了船，要与船上的人同往他施去躲避耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: But Jonah ran away from the Lord and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the Lord .
verses.textEnEsv: But Jonah rose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord . He went down to Joppa and found a ship going to Tarshish. So he paid the fare and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish, away from the presence of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: But Jonah arose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord. He went down to Joppa, and found a ship going to Tarshish; so he paid the fare, and went down into it, to go with them to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEnNlt: But Jonah got up and went in the opposite direction to get away from the Lord . He went down to the port of Joppa, where he found a ship leaving for Tarshish. He bought a ticket and went on board, hoping to escape from the Lord by sailing to Tarshish.
verses.textEnNasb: But Jonah got up to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord. So he went down to Joppa, found a ship that was going to Tarshish, paid the fare, and boarded it to go with them to Tarshish away from the presence of the Lord.
verses.textEn: But Jonah ran away from the Lord and headed for Tarshish. He went down to Joppa, where he found a ship bound for that port. After paying the fare, he went aboard and sailed for Tarshish to flee from the Lord .

verses.textZh: 但是耶和华在海上忽然刮起大风，于是海中狂风大作，船几乎要破裂了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但是耶和华在海上忽然刮起大风，于是海中狂风大作，船几乎要破裂了。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而耶和华使海中起大风，海就狂风大作，甚至船几乎破坏。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.
verses.textEnEsv: But the Lord hurled a great wind upon the sea, and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship threatened to break up.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord sent out a great wind on the sea, and there was a mighty tempest on the sea, so that the ship was about to be broken up.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord hurled a powerful wind over the sea, causing a violent storm that threatened to break the ship apart.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the Lord hurled a great wind on the sea and there was a great storm on the sea, so that the ship was about to break up.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord sent a great wind on the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship threatened to break up.

verses.textZh: 水手都很惧怕，各人向自己的神大声呼求；他们为了减轻船的重量，就把船上的东西拋在海里，可是约拿却下了船舱，躺着熟睡了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水手都很惧怕，各人向自己的神大声呼求；他们为了减轻船的重量，就把船上的东西拋在海里，可是约拿却下了船舱，躺着熟睡了。
verses.textZhCuv: 水手便惧怕，各人哀求自己的神。他们将船上的货物抛在海中，为要使船轻些。约拿已下到底舱，躺卧沉睡。
verses.textEnNiv: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the mariners were afraid, and each cried out to his god. And they hurled the cargo that was in the ship into the sea to lighten it for them. But Jonah had gone down into the inner part of the ship and had lain down and was fast asleep.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the mariners were afraid; and every man cried out to his god, and threw the cargo that was in the ship into the sea, to lighten the load. But Jonah had gone down into the lowest parts of the ship, had lain down, and was fast asleep.
verses.textEnNlt: Fearing for their lives, the desperate sailors shouted to their gods for help and threw the cargo overboard to lighten the ship. But all this time Jonah was sound asleep down in the hold.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sailors became afraid and every man cried out to his god, and they hurled the cargo which was in the ship into the sea to lighten it for them. But Jonah had gone below into the stern of the ship, had lain down, and fallen sound asleep.
verses.textEn: All the sailors were afraid and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the cargo into the sea to lighten the ship. But Jonah had gone below deck, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

verses.textZh: 船长走到他面前，对他说："你怎么啦！睡得那么熟？快起来，求告你的神吧！或者神会记念我们，使我们不至于丧命！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 船长走到他面前，对他说："你怎么啦！睡得那么熟？快起来，求告你的神吧！或者神会记念我们，使我们不至于丧命！"
verses.textZhCuv: 船主到他那里对他说：「你这沉睡的人哪，为何这样呢？起来，求告你的神，或者神顾念我们，使我们不致灭亡。」
verses.textEnNiv: The captain went to him and said, "How can you sleep? Get up and call on your god! Maybe he will take notice of us so that we will not perish."
verses.textEnEsv: So the captain came and said to him, "What do you mean, you sleeper? Arise, call out to your god! Perhaps the god will give a thought to us, that we may not perish."
verses.textEnNkjv: So the captain came to him, and said to him, "What do you mean, sleeper? Arise, call on your God; perhaps your God will consider us, so that we may not perish."
verses.textEnNlt: So the captain went down after him. "How can you sleep at a time like this?" he shouted. "Get up and pray to your god! Maybe he will pay attention to us and spare our lives."
verses.textEnNasb: So the captain approached him and said, "How is it that you are sleeping? Get up, call on your god! Perhaps your god will be concerned about us so that we will not perish."
verses.textEn: The captain went to him and said, "How can you sleep? Get up and call on your god! Maybe he will take notice of us so that we will not perish."

verses.textZh: 水手就彼此说："来吧！让我们抽签，好知道这场灾祸临到我们，是因谁的缘故。"于是他们抽签，结果抽中了约拿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 水手就彼此说："来吧！让我们抽签，好知道这场灾祸临到我们，是因谁的缘故。"于是他们抽签，结果抽中了约拿。
verses.textZhCuv: 船上的人彼此说：「来吧，我们掣签，看看这灾临到我们是因谁的缘故。」于是他们掣签，掣出约拿来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the sailors said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity." They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.
verses.textEnEsv: And they said to one another, "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know on whose account this evil has come upon us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
verses.textEnNkjv: And they said to one another, "Come, let us cast lots, that we may know for whose cause this trouble hascome upon us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the crew cast lots to see which of them had offended the gods and caused the terrible storm. When they did this, the lots identified Jonah as the culprit.
verses.textEnNasb: And each man said to his mate, "Come, let’s cast lots so that we may find out on whose account this catastrophe has struck us." So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
verses.textEn: Then the sailors said to each other, "Come, let us cast lots to find out who is responsible for this calamity." They cast lots and the lot fell on Jonah.

verses.textZh: 他们就对约拿说："请告诉我们，这场灾祸临到我们，是因谁的缘故？你是作甚么的？你从哪里来？你是哪一国的人？哪一族的人？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就对约拿说："请告诉我们，这场灾祸临到我们，是因谁的缘故？你是作甚么的？你从哪里来？你是哪一国的人？哪一族的人？"
verses.textZhCuv: 众人对他说：「请你告诉我们，这灾临到我们是因谁的缘故？你以何事为业？你从哪里来？你是哪一国？属哪一族的人？」
verses.textEnNiv: So they asked him, "Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What kind of work do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said to him, "Tell us on whose account this evil has come upon us. What is your occupation? And where do you come from? What is your country? And of what people are you?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him, "Please tell us! For whose cause is this trouble upon us? What is your occupation? And where do you come from? What is your country? And of what people are you?"
verses.textEnNlt: "Why has this awful storm come down on us?" they demanded. "Who are you? What is your line of work? What country are you from? What is your nationality?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then they said to him, "Tell us, now! On whose account has this catastrophe struck us? What is your occupation, and where do you come from? What is your country, and from what people are you?"
verses.textEn: So they asked him, "Tell us, who is responsible for making all this trouble for us? What kind of work do you do? Where do you come from? What is your country? From what people are you?"

verses.textZh: 他回答说："我是希伯来人，我敬畏耶和华天上的神，就是那创造海洋和陆地的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答说："我是希伯来人，我敬畏耶和华天上的神，就是那创造海洋和陆地的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「我是希伯来人。我敬畏耶和华－那创造沧海旱地之天上的神。」
verses.textEnNiv: He answered, "I am a Hebrew and I worship the Lord , the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to them, "I am a Hebrew, and I fear the Lord , the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he said to them, "I am a Hebrew; and I fear the Lord, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land."
verses.textEnNlt: Jonah answered, "I am a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord , the God of heaven, who made the sea and the land."
verses.textEnNasb: So he said to them, "I am a Hebrew, and I fear the Lord God of heaven who made the sea and the dry land."
verses.textEn: He answered, "I am a Hebrew and I worship the Lord , the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land."

verses.textZh: 众人就大大惧怕，对他说："你为甚么这样作呢？ "那些人知道他躲避耶和华，原来约拿告诉了他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众人就大大惧怕，对他说："你为甚么这样作呢？ "那些人知道他躲避耶和华，原来约拿告诉了他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们就大大惧怕，对他说：「你做的是什么事呢？」他们已经知道他躲避耶和华，因为他告诉了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: This terrified them and they asked, "What have you done?" (They knew he was running away from the Lord , because he had already told them so.)
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men were exceedingly afraid and said to him, "What is this that you have done!" For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the Lord , because he had told them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men were exceedingly afraid, and said to him, "Why have you done this?" For the men knew that he fled from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.
verses.textEnNlt: The sailors were terrified when they heard this, for he had already told them he was running away from the Lord . "Oh, why did you do it?" they groaned.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men became extremely afraid, and they said to him, " How could you do this?" For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.
verses.textEn: This terrified them and they asked, "What have you done?" (They knew he was running away from the Lord , because he had already told them so.)

verses.textZh: 因为海浪越来越汹涌，他们又对他说："我们该怎样处置你，才能叫海浪平静呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为海浪越来越汹涌，他们又对他说："我们该怎样处置你，才能叫海浪平静呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们问他说：「我们当向你怎样行，使海浪平静呢？」这话是因海浪越发翻腾。
verses.textEnNiv: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, "What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then they said to him, "What shall we do to you, that the sea may quiet down for us?" For the sea grew more and more tempestuous.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then they said to him, "What shall we do to you that the sea may be calm for us?"—for the sea was growing more tempestuous.
verses.textEnNlt: And since the storm was getting worse all the time, they asked him, "What should we do to you to stop this storm?"
verses.textEnNasb: So they said to him, "What should we do to you so that the sea will become calm for us?"—for the sea was becoming increasingly stormy.
verses.textEn: The sea was getting rougher and rougher. So they asked him, "What should we do to you to make the sea calm down for us?"

verses.textZh: 他回答说："你们把我抬起来，投在海里，海浪就会平静，因为我知道，这场大风暴临到你们，是为了我的缘故。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答说："你们把我抬起来，投在海里，海浪就会平静，因为我知道，这场大风暴临到你们，是为了我的缘故。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对他们说：「你们将我抬起来，抛在海中，海就平静了；我知道你们遭这大风是因我的缘故。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Pick me up and throw me into the sea," he replied, "and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you."
verses.textEnEsv: He said to them, "Pick me up and hurl me into the sea; then the sea will quiet down for you, for I know it is because of me that this great tempest has come upon you."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to them, "Pick me up and throw me into the sea; then the sea will become calm for you. For I know that this great tempest is because of me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Throw me into the sea," Jonah said, "and it will become calm again. I know that this terrible storm is all my fault."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to them, "Pick me up and hurl me into the sea. Then the sea will become calm for you, because I know that on account of me this great storm has come upon you."
verses.textEn: "Pick me up and throw me into the sea," he replied, "and it will become calm. I know that it is my fault that this great storm has come upon you."

verses.textZh: 那些人虽然破浪挣扎，要把船靠岸，却是不能，因为海浪不断汹涌扑来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人虽然破浪挣扎，要把船靠岸，却是不能，因为海浪不断汹涌扑来。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而那些人竭力荡桨，要把船拢岸，却是不能，因为海浪越发向他们翻腾。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.
verses.textEnEsv: Nevertheless, the men rowed hard to get back to dry land, but they could not, for the sea grew more and more tempestuous against them.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless the men rowed hard to return to land, but they could not, for the sea continued to grow more tempestuous against them.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead, the sailors rowed even harder to get the ship to the land. But the stormy sea was too violent for them, and they couldn’t make it.
verses.textEnNasb: However, the men rowed desperately to return to land, but they could not, because the sea was becoming even stormier against them.
verses.textEn: Instead, the men did their best to row back to land. But they could not, for the sea grew even wilder than before.

verses.textZh: 他们就呼求耶和华，说："耶和华啊！我们恳求你，不要因这人叫我们丧命；不要把无辜人的血归在我们身上，因为你耶和华是照自己所喜悦的行事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们就呼求耶和华，说："耶和华啊！我们恳求你，不要因这人叫我们丧命；不要把无辜人的血归在我们身上，因为你耶和华是照自己所喜悦的行事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们便求告耶和华说：「耶和华啊，我们恳求你，不要因这人的性命使我们死亡，不要使流无辜血的罪归与我们；因为你－耶和华是随自己的意旨行事。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then they cried out to the Lord , "Please, Lord , do not let us die for taking this man’s life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, Lord , have done as you pleased."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore they called out to the Lord , "O Lord , let us not perish for this man’s life, and lay not on us innocent blood, for you, O Lord , have done as it pleased you."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore they cried out to the Lord and said, "We pray, O Lord, please do not let us perish for this man’s life, and do not charge us with innocent blood; for You, O Lord, have done as it pleased You."
verses.textEnNlt: Then they cried out to the Lord , Jonah’s God. "O Lord ," they pleaded, "don’t make us die for this man’s sin. And don’t hold us responsible for his death. O Lord , you have sent this storm upon him for your own good reasons."
verses.textEnNasb: Then they cried out to the Lord and said, "We earnestly pray, O Lord, do not let us perish on account of this man’s life, and do not put innocent blood on us; for You, Lord, have done as You pleased."
verses.textEn: Then they cried out to the Lord , "Please, Lord , do not let us die for taking this man’s life. Do not hold us accountable for killing an innocent man, for you, Lord , have done as you pleased."

verses.textZh: 于是他们把约拿抬起来，投在海里，怒涛就平息了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他们把约拿抬起来，投在海里，怒涛就平息了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们遂将约拿抬起，抛在海中，海的狂浪就平息了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.
verses.textEnEsv: So they picked up Jonah and hurled him into the sea, and the sea ceased from its raging.
verses.textEnNkjv: So they picked up Jonah and threw him into the sea, and the sea ceased from its raging.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the sailors picked Jonah up and threw him into the raging sea, and the storm stopped at once!
verses.textEnNasb: So they picked up Jonah and hurled him into the sea, and the sea stopped its raging.
verses.textEn: Then they took Jonah and threw him overboard, and the raging sea grew calm.

verses.textZh: 那些人就大大敬畏耶和华，向他献祭和许愿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些人就大大敬畏耶和华，向他献祭和许愿。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些人便大大敬畏耶和华，向耶和华献祭，并且许愿。
verses.textEnNiv: At this the men greatly feared the Lord , and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the men feared the Lord exceedingly, and offered a sacrifice to the Lord and took vows.
verses.textEnNlt: The sailors were awestruck by the Lord ’s great power, and they offered him a sacrifice and vowed to serve him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the men became extremely afraid of the Lord, and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows.
verses.textEn: At this the men greatly feared the Lord , and they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows to him.

verses.textZh: 耶和华却安排了一条大鱼，把约拿吞下。约拿就在鱼腹中三日三夜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华却安排了一条大鱼，把约拿吞下。约拿就在鱼腹中三日三夜。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华安排一条大鱼吞了约拿，他在鱼腹中三日三夜。
verses.textEnNiv: Now the Lord provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord appointed a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the Lord had prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.
verses.textEnNlt: Now the Lord had arranged for a great fish to swallow Jonah. And Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord designated a great fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the stomach of the fish for three days and three nights.
verses.textEn: Now the Lord provided a huge fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.

verses.textZh: 约拿从鱼腹中向耶和华他的神祷告，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿从鱼腹中向耶和华他的神祷告，
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿在鱼腹中祷告耶和华－他的神，
verses.textEnNiv: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the Lord his God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the belly of the fish,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the fish’s belly.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from inside the fish.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonah prayed to the Lord his God from the stomach of the fish,
verses.textEn: From inside the fish Jonah prayed to the Lord his God.

verses.textZh: 说： "我从患难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我； 我从阴间的深府呼求， 你就垂听我的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 说： "我从患难中求告耶和华， 他就应允我； 我从阴间的深府呼求， 你就垂听我的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 说： 我遭遇患难求告耶和华， 你就应允我； 从阴间的深处呼求， 你就俯听我的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "In my distress I called to the Lord , and he answered me. From deep in the realm of the dead I called for help, and you listened to my cry.
verses.textEnEsv: saying, "I called out to the Lord , out of my distress, and he answered me; out of the belly of Sheol I cried, and you heard my voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said: "I cried out to the Lord because of my affliction, And He answered me. "Out of the belly of Sheol I cried, And You heard my voice.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "I cried out to the Lord in my great trouble, and he answered me. I called to you from the land of the dead, and Lord , you heard me!
verses.textEnNasb: and he said, "I called out of my distress to the Lord, And He answered me. I called for help from the depth of Sheol; You heard my voice.
verses.textEn: He said: "In my distress I called to the Lord , and he answered me. From deep in the realm of the dead I called for help, and you listened to my cry.

verses.textZh: 你把我投入深海， 在海洋的深处， 大水环绕我； 你的洪涛、你的波浪，都漫过我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你把我投入深海， 在海洋的深处， 大水环绕我； 你的洪涛、你的波浪，都漫过我。
verses.textZhCuv: 你将我投下深渊， 就是海的深处； 大水环绕我， 你的波浪洪涛都漫过我身。
verses.textEnNiv: You hurled me into the depths, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.
verses.textEnEsv: For you cast me into the deep, into the heart of the seas, and the flood surrounded me; all your breakers and your waves passed over me.
verses.textEnNkjv: For You cast me into the deep, Into the heart of the seas, And the floods surrounded me; All Your billows and Your waves passed over me.
verses.textEnNlt: You threw me into the ocean depths, and I sank down to the heart of the sea. The mighty waters engulfed me; I was buried beneath your wild and stormy waves.
verses.textEnNasb: "For You threw me into the deep, Into the heart of the seas, And the current flowed around me. All Your breakers and waves passed over me.
verses.textEn: You hurled me into the depths, into the very heart of the seas, and the currents swirled about me; all your waves and breakers swept over me.

verses.textZh: 我说：‘我虽从你眼前被赶逐， 我仍要仰望你的圣殿。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说：‘我虽从你眼前被赶逐， 我仍要仰望你的圣殿。’
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：我从你眼前虽被驱逐， 我仍要仰望你的圣殿。
verses.textEnNiv: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
verses.textEnEsv: Then I said, ‘I am driven away from your sight; yet I shall again look upon your holy temple.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I said, ‘I have been cast out of Your sight; Yet I will look again toward Your holy temple.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then I said, ‘O Lord , you have driven me from your presence. Yet I will look once more toward your holy Temple.’
verses.textEnNasb: "So I said, ‘I have been cast out of Your sight. Nevertheless I will look again toward Your holy temple.’
verses.textEn: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

verses.textZh: 众水包围我，几乎置我于死地； 深渊环绕我； 海草缠裹我的头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 众水包围我，几乎置我于死地； 深渊环绕我； 海草缠裹我的头。
verses.textZhCuv: 诸水环绕我，几乎淹没我； 深渊围住我； 海草缠绕我的头。
verses.textEnNiv: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.
verses.textEnEsv: The waters closed in over me to take my life; the deep surrounded me; weeds were wrapped about my head.
verses.textEnNkjv: The waters surrounded me, even to my soul; The deep closed around me; Weeds were wrapped around my head.
verses.textEnNlt: "I sank beneath the waves, and the waters closed over me. Seaweed wrapped itself around my head.
verses.textEnNasb: "Water encompassed me to the point of death. The deep flowed around me, Seaweed was wrapped around my head.
verses.textEn: The engulfing waters threatened me, the deep surrounded me; seaweed was wrapped around my head.

verses.textZh: 我下沉直到山麓， 大地的门闩把我永远关闭； 耶和华我的神啊！你却把我的性命从坑中拉上来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我下沉直到山麓， 大地的门闩把我永远关闭； 耶和华我的神啊！你却把我的性命从坑中拉上来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我下到山根， 地的门将我永远关住。 耶和华－我的神啊， 你却将我的性命从坑中救出来。
verses.textEnNiv: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you, Lord my God, brought my life up from the pit.
verses.textEnEsv: To the roots of the mountains I went down, to the land whose bars closed upon me forever. Yet you brought up my life from the pit, O Lord my God.
verses.textEnNkjv: I went down to the moorings of the mountains; The earth with its bars closed behind me forever; Yet You have brought up my life from the pit, O Lord, my God.
verses.textEnNlt: I sank down to the very roots of the mountains. I was imprisoned in the earth, whose gates lock shut forever. But you, O Lord my God, snatched me from the jaws of death!
verses.textEnNasb: "I descended to the base of the mountains. The earth with its bars was around me forever, But You have brought up my life from the pit, Lord my God.
verses.textEn: To the roots of the mountains I sank down; the earth beneath barred me in forever. But you, Lord my God, brought my life up from the pit.

verses.textZh: 当我心灵疲弱时， 我就思念耶和华； 我的祷告直达你面前， 进入你的圣殿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当我心灵疲弱时， 我就思念耶和华； 我的祷告直达你面前， 进入你的圣殿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我心在我里面发昏的时候， 我就想念耶和华。 我的祷告进入你的圣殿， 达到你的面前。
verses.textEnNiv: "When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, Lord , and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.
verses.textEnEsv: When my life was fainting away, I remembered the Lord , and my prayer came to you, into your holy temple.
verses.textEnNkjv: "When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the Lord; And my prayer went up to You, Into Your holy temple.
verses.textEnNlt: As my life was slipping away, I remembered the Lord . And my earnest prayer went out to you in your holy Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: "While I was fainting away, I remembered the Lord, And my prayer came to You, Into Your holy temple.
verses.textEn: "When my life was ebbing away, I remembered you, Lord , and my prayer rose to you, to your holy temple.

verses.textZh: 那敬奉虚妄之偶像的人， 实在是离弃了怜爱他们的神 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那敬奉虚妄之偶像的人， 实在是离弃了怜爱他们的神 。
verses.textZhCuv: 那信奉虚无之神的人， 离弃怜爱他们的主；
verses.textEnNiv: "Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from God’s love for them.
verses.textEnEsv: Those who pay regard to vain idols forsake their hope of steadfast love.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Those who regard worthless idols Forsake their own Mercy.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who worship false gods turn their backs on all God’s mercies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Those who are followers of worthless idols Abandon their faithfulness,
verses.textEn: "Those who cling to worthless idols turn away from God’s love for them.

verses.textZh: 至于我，我要带着感谢的声音向你献祭； 我所许的愿，我必偿还。 救恩是属于耶和华的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于我，我要带着感谢的声音向你献祭； 我所许的愿，我必偿还。 救恩是属于耶和华的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我必用感谢的声音献祭与你。 我所许的愿，我必偿还。 救恩出于耶和华。
verses.textEnNiv: But I, with shouts of grateful praise, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. I will say, ‘Salvation comes from the Lord .’ "
verses.textEnEsv: But I with the voice of thanksgiving will sacrifice to you; what I have vowed I will pay. Salvation belongs to the Lord !"
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will sacrifice to You With the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay what I have vowed. Salvation is of the Lord."
verses.textEnNlt: But I will offer sacrifices to you with songs of praise, and I will fulfill all my vows. For my salvation comes from the Lord alone."
verses.textEnNasb: But I will sacrifice to You With a voice of thanksgiving. That which I have vowed I will pay. Salvation is from the Lord."
verses.textEn: But I, with shouts of grateful praise, will sacrifice to you. What I have vowed I will make good. I will say, ‘Salvation comes from the Lord .’ "

verses.textZh: 于是耶和华吩咐那鱼，鱼就把约拿吐在陆地上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是耶和华吩咐那鱼，鱼就把约拿吐在陆地上。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华吩咐鱼，鱼就把约拿吐在旱地上。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah out upon the dry land.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the Lord spoke to the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord ordered the fish to spit Jonah out onto the beach.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah up onto the dry land.
verses.textEn: And the Lord commanded the fish, and it vomited Jonah onto dry land.

verses.textZh: 耶和华的话再次临到约拿，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华的话再次临到约拿，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华的话二次临到约拿说：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time:
verses.textEnEsv: Then the word of the Lord came to Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the word of the Lord came to Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord spoke to Jonah a second time:
verses.textEnNasb: Now the word of the Lord came to Jonah the second time, saying,
verses.textEn: Then the word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time:

verses.textZh: "起来！到尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的话。"
verses.textZhCnvs: "起来！到尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的话。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你起来！往尼尼微大城去，向其中的居民宣告我所吩咐你的话。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you."
verses.textEnEsv: "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and call out against it the message that I tell you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city, and preach to it the message that I tell you."
verses.textEnNlt: "Get up and go to the great city of Nineveh, and deliver the message I have given you."
verses.textEnNasb: "Arise, go to Nineveh, the great city, and proclaim to it the proclamation which I am going to tell you."
verses.textEn: "Go to the great city of Nineveh and proclaim to it the message I give you."

verses.textZh: 约拿就动身，照耶和华的话往尼尼微去了，这尼尼微是一座极大的城 ，要三天才能走完。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿就动身，照耶和华的话往尼尼微去了，这尼尼微是一座极大的城 ，要三天才能走完。
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿便照耶和华的话起来，往尼尼微去。这尼尼微是极大的城，有三日的路程。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonah obeyed the word of the Lord and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very large city; it took three days to go through it.
verses.textEnEsv: So Jonah arose and went to Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord . Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, three days’ journey in breadth.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonah arose and went to Nineveh, according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly great city, a three-day journey inextent.
verses.textEnNlt: This time Jonah obeyed the Lord ’s command and went to Nineveh, a city so large that it took three days to see it all.
verses.textEnNasb: So Jonah got up and went to Nineveh according to the word of the Lord. Now Nineveh was an exceedingly large city, a three days’ walk.
verses.textEn: Jonah obeyed the word of the Lord and went to Nineveh. Now Nineveh was a very large city; it took three days to go through it.

verses.textZh: 约拿进城，走了一天，就宣告说："再过四十天，尼尼微就要毁灭了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿进城，走了一天，就宣告说："再过四十天，尼尼微就要毁灭了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 约拿进城走了一日，宣告说：「再等四十日，尼尼微必倾覆了！」
verses.textEnNiv: Jonah began by going a day’s journey into the city, proclaiming, "Forty more days and Nineveh will be overthrown."
verses.textEnEsv: Jonah began to go into the city, going a day’s journey. And he called out, "Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!"
verses.textEnNkjv: And Jonah began to enter the city on the first day’s walk. Then he cried out and said, "Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!"
verses.textEnNlt: On the day Jonah entered the city, he shouted to the crowds: "Forty days from now Nineveh will be destroyed!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonah began to go through the city one day’s walk; and he cried out and said, "Forty more days, and Nineveh will be overthrown."
verses.textEn: Jonah began by going a day’s journey into the city, proclaiming, "Forty more days and Nineveh will be overthrown."

verses.textZh: 尼尼微人信了神，就宣告禁食，从大到小，都穿上麻衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼尼微人信了神，就宣告禁食，从大到小，都穿上麻衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼尼微人信服神，便宣告禁食，从最大的到至小的都穿麻衣 。
verses.textEnNiv: The Ninevites believed God. A fast was proclaimed, and all of them, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.
verses.textEnEsv: And the people of Nineveh believed God. They called for a fast and put on sackcloth, from the greatest of them to the least of them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the people of Nineveh believed God, proclaimed a fast, and put on sackcloth, from the greatest to the least of them.
verses.textEnNlt: The people of Nineveh believed God’s message, and from the greatest to the least, they declared a fast and put on burlap to show their sorrow.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the people of Nineveh believed in God; and they called a fast and put on sackcloth, from the greatest to the least of them.
verses.textEn: The Ninevites believed God. A fast was proclaimed, and all of them, from the greatest to the least, put on sackcloth.

verses.textZh: 这事传到尼尼微王那里，他就起来，离开宝座，脱去王袍，披上麻衣，坐在炉灰中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事传到尼尼微王那里，他就起来，离开宝座，脱去王袍，披上麻衣，坐在炉灰中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这信息传到尼尼微王的耳中，他就下了宝座，脱下朝服，披上麻布，坐在灰中。
verses.textEnNiv: When Jonah’s warning reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.
verses.textEnEsv: The word reached the king of Nineveh, and he arose from his throne, removed his robe, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat in ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then word came to the king of Nineveh; and he arose from his throne and laid aside his robe, covered himself with sackcloth and sat in ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: When the king of Nineveh heard what Jonah was saying, he stepped down from his throne and took off his royal robes. He dressed himself in burlap and sat on a heap of ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: When the word reached the king of Nineveh, he got up from his throne, removed his robe from himself, covered himself with sackcloth, and sat on the dust.
verses.textEn: When Jonah’s warning reached the king of Nineveh, he rose from his throne, took off his royal robes, covered himself with sackcloth and sat down in the dust.

verses.textZh: 他又传谕全尼尼微，说："王和大臣有令：‘人、畜、牛、羊，都不准尝甚么，不准吃，也不准喝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又传谕全尼尼微，说："王和大臣有令：‘人、畜、牛、羊，都不准尝甚么，不准吃，也不准喝。
verses.textZhCuv: 他又使人遍告尼尼微通城，说：「王和大臣有令，人不可尝什么，牲畜、牛羊不可吃草，也不可喝水。
verses.textEnNiv: This is the proclamation he issued in Nineveh: "By the decree of the king and his nobles: Do not let people or animals, herds or flocks, taste anything; do not let them eat or drink.
verses.textEnEsv: And he issued a proclamation and published through Nineveh, "By the decree of the king and his nobles: Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything. Let them not feed or drink water,
verses.textEnNkjv: And he caused it to be proclaimed and published throughout Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles, saying, Let neither man nor beast, herd nor flock, taste anything; do not let them eat, or drink water.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king and his nobles sent this decree throughout the city: "No one, not even the animals from your herds and flocks, may eat or drink anything at all.
verses.textEnNasb: And he issued a proclamation, and it said, "In Nineveh by the decree of the king and his nobles: No person, animal, herd, or flock is to taste anything. They are not to eat, or drink water.
verses.textEn: This is the proclamation he issued in Nineveh: "By the decree of the king and his nobles: Do not let people or animals, herds or flocks, taste anything; do not let them eat or drink.

verses.textZh: 不论人畜，都要披上麻衣；各人要恳切呼求神，悔改，离开恶行，摒弃手中的强暴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不论人畜，都要披上麻衣；各人要恳切呼求神，悔改，离开恶行，摒弃手中的强暴。
verses.textZhCuv: 人与牲畜都当披上麻布；人要切切求告神。各人回头离开所行的恶道，丢弃手中的强暴。
verses.textEnNiv: But let people and animals be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.
verses.textEnEsv: but let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and let them call out mightily to God. Let everyone turn from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
verses.textEnNkjv: But let man and beast be covered with sackcloth, and cry mightily to God; yes, let every one turn from his evil way and from the violence that is in his hands.
verses.textEnNlt: People and animals alike must wear garments of mourning, and everyone must pray earnestly to God. They must turn from their evil ways and stop all their violence.
verses.textEnNasb: But every person and animal must be covered with sackcloth; and people are to call on God vehemently, and they are to turn, each one from his evil way, and from the violence which is in their hands.
verses.textEn: But let people and animals be covered with sackcloth. Let everyone call urgently on God. Let them give up their evil ways and their violence.

verses.textZh: 或者神回心转意，不发烈怒，使我们不致灭亡。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: 或者神回心转意，不发烈怒，使我们不致灭亡。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 或者神转意后悔，不发烈怒，使我们不致灭亡，也未可知。」
verses.textEnNiv: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish."
verses.textEnEsv: Who knows? God may turn and relent and turn from his fierce anger, so that we may not perish."
verses.textEnNkjv: Who can tell if God will turn and relent, and turn away from His fierce anger, so that we may not perish?
verses.textEnNlt: Who can tell? Perhaps even yet God will change his mind and hold back his fierce anger from destroying us."
verses.textEnNasb: Who knows, God may turn and relent, and turn from His burning anger so that we will not perish."
verses.textEn: Who knows? God may yet relent and with compassion turn from his fierce anger so that we will not perish."

verses.textZh: 神看见他们所作的，就是悔改离开恶行，神就转意，不把所说的灾祸降在他们身上了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 神看见他们所作的，就是悔改离开恶行，神就转意，不把所说的灾祸降在他们身上了。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是神察看他们的行为，见他们离开恶道，他就后悔，不把所说的灾祸降与他们了。
verses.textEnNiv: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he relented and did not bring on them the destruction he had threatened.
verses.textEnEsv: When God saw what they did, how they turned from their evil way, God relented of the disaster that he had said he would do to them, and he did not do it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God saw their works, that they turned from their evil way; and God relented from the disaster that He had said He would bring upon them, and He did not do it.
verses.textEnNlt: When God saw what they had done and how they had put a stop to their evil ways, he changed his mind and did not carry out the destruction he had threatened.
verses.textEnNasb: When God saw their deeds, that they turned from their evil way, then God relented of the disaster which He had declared He would bring on them. So He did not do it.
verses.textEn: When God saw what they did and how they turned from their evil ways, he relented and did not bring on them the destruction he had threatened.

verses.textZh: 约拿对这事非常不高兴，并且发起怒来，
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿对这事非常不高兴，并且发起怒来，
verses.textZhCuv: 这事约拿大大不悦，且甚发怒，
verses.textEnNiv: But to Jonah this seemed very wrong, and he became angry.
verses.textEnEsv: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he was angry.
verses.textEnNkjv: But it displeased Jonah exceedingly, and he became angry.
verses.textEnNlt: This change of plans greatly upset Jonah, and he became very angry.
verses.textEnNasb: But it greatly displeased Jonah, and he became angry.
verses.textEn: But to Jonah this seemed very wrong, and he became angry.

verses.textZh: 就向耶和华祷告，说："耶和华啊！我还在本国的时候，不是这样说过吗？我知道你是有恩典有怜悯的神，不轻易发怒，并且有丰盛的慈爱，转意不降灾祸，所以我才急忙逃往他施去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就向耶和华祷告，说："耶和华啊！我还在本国的时候，不是这样说过吗？我知道你是有恩典有怜悯的神，不轻易发怒，并且有丰盛的慈爱，转意不降灾祸，所以我才急忙逃往他施去。
verses.textZhCuv: 就祷告耶和华说：「耶和华啊，我在本国的时候岂不是这样说吗？我知道你是有恩典、有怜悯的神，不轻易发怒，有丰盛的慈爱，并且后悔不降所说的灾，所以我急速逃往他施去。
verses.textEnNiv: He prayed to the Lord , "Isn’t this what I said, Lord , when I was still at home? That is what I tried to forestall by fleeing to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.
verses.textEnEsv: And he prayed to the Lord and said, "O Lord , is not this what I said when I was yet in my country? That is why I made haste to flee to Tarshish; for I knew that you are a gracious God and merciful, slow to anger and abounding in steadfast love, and relenting from disaster.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he prayed to the Lord, and said, "Ah, Lord, was not this what I said when I was still in my country? Therefore I fled previously to Tarshish; for I know that You are a gracious and merciful God, slow to anger and abundant in lovingkindness, One who relents from doing harm.
verses.textEnNlt: So he complained to the Lord about it: "Didn’t I say before I left home that you would do this, Lord ? That is why I ran away to Tarshish! I knew that you are a merciful and compassionate God, slow to get angry and filled with unfailing love. You are eager to turn back from destroying people.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he prayed to the Lord and said, "Please Lord, was this not what I said when I was still in my own country? Therefore in anticipation of this I fled to Tarshish, since I knew that You are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abundant in mercy, and One who relents of disaster.
verses.textEn: He prayed to the Lord , "Isn’t this what I said, Lord , when I was still at home? That is what I tried to forestall by fleeing to Tarshish. I knew that you are a gracious and compassionate God, slow to anger and abounding in love, a God who relents from sending calamity.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！现在求你取去我的性命吧，因为我死了比活着还好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！现在求你取去我的性命吧，因为我死了比活着还好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华啊，现在求你取我的命吧！因为我死了比活着还好。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now, Lord , take away my life, for it is better for me to die than to live."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore now, O Lord , please take my life from me, for it is better for me to die than to live."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore now, O Lord, please take my life from me, for itis better for me to die than to live!"
verses.textEnNlt: Just kill me now, Lord ! I’d rather be dead than alive if what I predicted will not happen."
verses.textEnNasb: So now, Lord, please take my life from me, for death is better to me than life."
verses.textEn: Now, Lord , take away my life, for it is better for me to die than to live."

verses.textZh: 耶和华回答说："你这样发怒对不对呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华回答说："你这样发怒对不对呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「你这样发怒合乎理吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord replied, "Is it right for you to be angry?"
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "Do you do well to be angry?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Lord said, "Isit right for you to be angry?"
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord replied, "Is it right for you to be angry about this?"
verses.textEnNasb: But the Lord said, "Do you have a good reason to be angry?"
verses.textEn: But the Lord replied, "Is it right for you to be angry?"

verses.textZh: 约拿出了城，在城东坐下；他在那里搭了一座棚，坐在棚荫之下，要看看那城究竟怎样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 约拿出了城，在城东坐下；他在那里搭了一座棚，坐在棚荫之下，要看看那城究竟怎样。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是约拿出城，坐在城的东边，在那里为自己搭了一座棚，坐在棚的荫下，要看看那城究竟如何。
verses.textEnNiv: Jonah had gone out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.
verses.textEnEsv: Jonah went out of the city and sat to the east of the city and made a booth for himself there. He sat under it in the shade, till he should see what would become of the city.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Jonah went out of the city and sat on the east side of the city. There he made himself a shelter and sat under it in the shade, till he might see what would become of the city.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Jonah went out to the east side of the city and made a shelter to sit under as he waited to see what would happen to the city.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Jonah left the city and sat down east of it. There he made a shelter for himself and sat under it in the shade, until he could see what would happen in the city.
verses.textEn: Jonah had gone out and sat down at a place east of the city. There he made himself a shelter, sat in its shade and waited to see what would happen to the city.

verses.textZh: 耶和华神安排一棵蓖麻，使它长起来高过约拿，成了阴影遮盖他的头，免他受苦；约拿因这棵蓖麻，就大大欢畅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华神安排一棵蓖麻，使它长起来高过约拿，成了阴影遮盖他的头，免他受苦；约拿因这棵蓖麻，就大大欢畅。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华神安排一棵蓖麻，使其发生高过约拿，影儿遮盖他的头，救他脱离苦楚；约拿因这棵蓖麻大大喜乐。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the Lord God provided a leafy plant and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the plant.
verses.textEnEsv: Now the Lord God appointed a plant and made it come up over Jonah, that it might be a shade over his head, to save him from his discomfort. So Jonah was exceedingly glad because of the plant.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord God prepared a plant and made it come up over Jonah, that it might be shade for his head to deliver him from his misery. So Jonah was very grateful for the plant.
verses.textEnNlt: And the Lord God arranged for a leafy plant to grow there, and soon it spread its broad leaves over Jonah’s head, shading him from the sun. This eased his discomfort, and Jonah was very grateful for the plant.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord God designated a plant, and it grew up over Jonah to be a shade over his head, to relieve him of his discomfort. And Jonah was overjoyed about the plant.
verses.textEn: Then the Lord God provided a leafy plant and made it grow up over Jonah to give shade for his head to ease his discomfort, and Jonah was very happy about the plant.

verses.textZh: 次日黎明的时候，神安排一条虫子，蛀蚀这棵蓖麻，蓖麻就枯槁了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 次日黎明的时候，神安排一条虫子，蛀蚀这棵蓖麻，蓖麻就枯槁了。
verses.textZhCuv: 次日黎明，神却安排一条虫子咬这蓖麻，以致枯槁。
verses.textEnNiv: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the plant so that it withered.
verses.textEnEsv: But when dawn came up the next day, God appointed a worm that attacked the plant, so that it withered.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as morning dawned the next day God prepared a worm, and it so damaged the plant that it withered.
verses.textEnNlt: But God also arranged for a worm! The next morning at dawn the worm ate through the stem of the plant so that it withered away.
verses.textEnNasb: But God designated a worm when dawn came the next day, and it attacked the plant and it withered.
verses.textEn: But at dawn the next day God provided a worm, which chewed the plant so that it withered.

verses.textZh: 日出的时候，神又安排炎热的东风。烈日晒在约拿的头上，以致发昏，他就为自己求死，说："我死了比活着还好。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 日出的时候，神又安排炎热的东风。烈日晒在约拿的头上，以致发昏，他就为自己求死，说："我死了比活着还好。"
verses.textZhCuv: 日头出来的时候，神安排炎热的东风，日头曝晒约拿的头，使他发昏，他就为自己求死，说：「我死了比活着还好！」
verses.textEnNiv: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, "It would be better for me to die than to live."
verses.textEnEsv: When the sun rose, God appointed a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on the head of Jonah so that he was faint. And he asked that he might die and said, "It is better for me to die than to live."
verses.textEnNkjv: And it happened, when the sun arose, that God prepared a vehement east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he grew faint. Then he wished death for himself, and said, "Itis better for me to die than to live."
verses.textEnNlt: And as the sun grew hot, God arranged for a scorching east wind to blow on Jonah. The sun beat down on his head until he grew faint and wished to die. "Death is certainly better than living like this!" he exclaimed.
verses.textEnNasb: And when the sun came up God designated a scorching east wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah’s head so that he became faint, and he begged with all his soul to die, saying, "Death is better to me than life!"
verses.textEn: When the sun rose, God provided a scorching east wind, and the sun blazed on Jonah’s head so that he grew faint. He wanted to die, and said, "It would be better for me to die than to live."

verses.textZh: 神问约拿："你因这棵蓖麻这样发怒，对不对呢？"约拿说："我发怒以至于死都是对的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 神问约拿："你因这棵蓖麻这样发怒，对不对呢？"约拿说："我发怒以至于死都是对的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 神对约拿说：「你因这棵蓖麻发怒合乎理吗？」他说：「我发怒以至于死，都合乎理！」
verses.textEnNiv: But God said to Jonah, "Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?" "It is," he said. "And I’m so angry I wish I were dead."
verses.textEnEsv: But God said to Jonah, "Do you do well to be angry for the plant?" And he said, "Yes, I do well to be angry, angry enough to die."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then God said to Jonah, "Isit right for you to be angry about the plant?" And he said, "Itis right for me to be angry, even to death!"
verses.textEnNlt: Then God said to Jonah, "Is it right for you to be angry because the plant died?" "Yes," Jonah retorted, "even angry enough to die!"
verses.textEnNasb: But God said to Jonah, "Do you have a good reason to be angry about the plant?" And he said, "I have good reason to be angry, even to the point of death!"
verses.textEn: But God said to Jonah, "Is it right for you to be angry about the plant?" "It is," he said. "And I’m so angry I wish I were dead."

verses.textZh: 耶和华说："这棵蓖麻，不是你栽种的，也不是你使它长大的，一夜长成，一夜死去，你尚且爱惜它，
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华说："这棵蓖麻，不是你栽种的，也不是你使它长大的，一夜长成，一夜死去，你尚且爱惜它，
verses.textZhCuv: 耶和华说：「这蓖麻不是你栽种的，也不是你培养的；一夜发生，一夜干死，你尚且爱惜；
verses.textEnNiv: But the Lord said, "You have been concerned about this plant, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord said, "You pity the plant, for which you did not labor, nor did you make it grow, which came into being in a night and perished in a night.
verses.textEnNkjv: But the Lord said, "You have had pity on the plant for which you have not labored, nor made it grow, which came up in a night and perished in a night.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the Lord said, "You feel sorry about the plant, though you did nothing to put it there. It came quickly and died quickly.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Lord said, "You had compassion on the plant, for which you did not work and which you did not cause to grow, which came up overnight and perished overnight.
verses.textEn: But the Lord said, "You have been concerned about this plant, though you did not tend it or make it grow. It sprang up overnight and died overnight.

verses.textZh: 何况这尼尼微大城，其中不晓得分辨左右手的有十二万多人，并且有许多牲畜，我怎能不爱惜呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 何况这尼尼微大城，其中不晓得分辨左右手的有十二万多人，并且有许多牲畜，我怎能不爱惜呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 何况这尼尼微大城，其中不能分辨左手右手的有十二万多人，并有许多牲畜，我岂能不爱惜呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: And should I not have concern for the great city of Nineveh, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left—and also many animals?"
verses.textEnEsv: And should not I pity Nineveh, that great city, in which there are more than 120,000 persons who do not know their right hand from their left, and also much cattle?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And should I not pity Nineveh, that great city, in which are more than one hundred and twenty thousand persons who cannot discern between their right hand and their left—and much livestock?"
verses.textEnNlt: But Nineveh has more than 120,000 people living in spiritual darkness, not to mention all the animals. Shouldn’t I feel sorry for such a great city?"
verses.textEnNasb: Should I not also have compassion on Nineveh, the great city in which there are more than 120,000 people, who do not know the difference between their right hand and their left, as well as many animals?"
verses.textEn: And should I not have concern for the great city of Nineveh, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand people who cannot tell their right hand from their left—and also many animals?"
